methodology.evidence: intl_growth_stock_scored.csv: all 8 shortlisted names have fundamentals_pit False with FY2025 statements filed in 2026 (Bajaj: FY to 2026-03). All 4 faded leaders are point-in-time on FY2016. The fundamental score is 50% of the composite. Price-only top 8: CSU, BAJ, DOL, Tencent, TSMC, Keyence, REA, Naspers; SK Hynix would be 19th, Novo 9th, AIA 11th. shortlist.md flags the issue but does not quantify it. methodology.finding: 'Hedging improved USD returns for every non-HKD name' comes from the 2018-26 dollar rally, not from carry
methodology.evidence: The hedge formula is correct: hedged = u + fp - f - 5 bp, with fp from US_3M(t-1) against the local 3M(t-1), rolled monthly (intl_growth.py hedged_returns). Carry was a cost for AUD (0.31%/yr), KRW (0.20%), CAD (0.13%) and INR (3.42%), and a gain only for DKK (0.89%) and TWD (0.25%). The gains came from the depreciation avoided and from lower variance drag (0.36-1.32%/yr).

methodology.finding: Multiple testing: only TSMC clears a Bonferroni bar, and no name has DSR >= 0.95
